events.title: GitHub Actions generally available
events.summary: GitHub announced Actions generally available at Universe on November 13, 2019 — native CI/CD workflows defined in YAML inside repositories.
events.about: GitHub Actions runs jobs on push, pull request, or schedule — build, test, deploy with marketplace actions for AWS, Docker, and npm. Workflows live in `.github/workflows/` beside the code they test. It displaced Travis CI for many open-source projects and integrated CI into the forge developers already used.

narrative.whyChosen: GitHub Actions brought CI/CD into the platform that already hosted the code.
narrative.whyImportant: It made automated testing and deployment the default for GitHub-hosted projects worldwide.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams juggled separate CI services, webhooks, and permissions outside their git host.
